note: A story of a Jewish queen in the Persian court who risks her life to save her people. God is not named in the book. Not cited by the curriculum or the Scriptural Appendix.
coverage_note: Indexed selectively. Not indexed: the royal banquet and Vashti's removal (1), the selection of Esther (2), Haman's plot and the decree (3), the banquets and Haman's fall (5-7), and the decree of self-defence and the reprisals (8-9:19), which the index does not turn into formation guidance. Haman's pride (5:9-14, 6:6-12) is a clear counter-example of C22 and may be added on review.

entries.pericope: Who knows if you haven't come to the kingdom for such a time as this?… I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish
entries.connection: Esther is queen in a foreign court, her identity hidden, and a decree has been issued to destroy her people. To approach the king uninvited is death. Mordecai's message: 'Don't think to yourself that you will escape in the king's house any more than all the Jews… Who knows if you haven't come to the kingdom for such a time as this?' Her answer is a fast and a decision: 'Go, gather together all the Jews… and fast for me… Then I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish.' The Citizen-Stranger at the highest level of a foreign society, choosing her people over her safety. C17, and C16's service at the point of personal risk. God is not named in the book; the fast is.

entries.pericope: The month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness… days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy
entries.connection: Purim is instituted as an annual feast, and its observance is defined to include the poor: 'that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.' Habitual Almsgiving written into the calendar — a rhythm, not an impulse (medium). C28's feast and C14's household celebration. The reprisals of 9:1-16 are not indexed.
